name: OB Holdings Berhad
summary: OB Holdings Berhad engages in the manufacture and sale of fortified food and beverage and dietary supplements. It also offers contract packing services of milk powder, tea leaves, honey, herb powder, fruit powder, and liquid chlorophyll into retail packaging sizes. In addition, the company trades milk powder and other activities. The company offers its products under its brands comprising Bonlife, GoHerb, Zen Night, Sleepin' Beaute, EZ:Nitez, Beyoute, Zen Youte, and Zenliv. OB Holdings Berhad was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Batu Caves, Malaysia.
